## LmdbQueue class

FIFO queue over LMDB with single-writer transaction dequeue.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class LmdbQueue<S extends IQueueSchema> 
```

## Remarks

Backed by a dedicated sub-DB per queue name. Enqueue bumps a monotonic sequence counter (root-DB meta sub-DB) and stores the payload in ONE synchronous transaction (v2 — previously the counter bump and the payload put were separate commits), so the zero-padded id and the payload are always visible atomically, FIFO order preserved even across processes. Dequeue reads the first key via a synchronous cursor and deletes it in ONE synchronous transaction — no async `first()` holding the write lock open across a microtask. At-least-once semantics — a crash between read and delete may redeliver.
